title: Documents and transactions API

scenes.say: In this video, you'll check a single document over the API, then feed your customers' transactions into transaction monitoring.

show.subtitle: Sentinel by DeepTrack · Developer quick start

scenes.say: The Documents API checks one document on its own, with no selfie. Choose the kind: an identity document, a proof of address, or a KRA PIN certificate. Your key needs the Run IDP document checks scope.
Send a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, base64-encoded, up to about 730 kilobytes. Send the original file where you can. Re-saving it removes the hidden data that reveals edited or AI-made files.
For an ID card, send the front and the back, because the back carries the MRZ. Add what the customer told you, such as their name and date of birth, and Sentinel checks the document against it.
A proof of address or KRA PIN certificate uses the same call, with one file. Add the expected address and a maximum age, or the expected KRA PIN.

A pass means no fraud signals. Review means a high or medium finding, like a name mismatch or an old bill. Reject means a critical finding, like an expired document. Anything that doesn't pass opens a case for your team.
Now transactions. Send up to 500 in one batch, from your core banking system, wallet or M-Pesa integration. This needs the Manage AML monitoring scope, and it uses no credits.

show.subtitle: Up to 500 per batch · scope: Manage AML monitoring

scenes.say: Give each transaction an externalId that never changes, such as the M-Pesa receipt number. For customerRef, use the reference of the customer's KYC or AML check where you can, so stricter rules apply to high-risk customers.
The response counts what was accepted and what was a duplicate, and lists every rejected row with its position and the error. A 202 can still contain rejected rows, so always check them.

Resending is safe. A transaction already stored is counted as a duplicate, never stored twice. On a timeout or a 429, wait, then send the same batch again. With a test key, rows are checked but nothing is stored.

show.subtitle: Same externalId → counted as a duplicate, never stored twice

scenes.say: When a rule is met, an alert appears on the Transactions page, usually within a minute. Your compliance team works it there.
That's documents and transactions over the API. To learn more, open chapters C3 and C5 in Help.
